rooms.name: The Void
rooms.desc: You don't think that you are not floating in nothing.

rooms.name: Limbo
rooms.desc:
You are floating in a formless void, detached from all sensation of physical
matter, surrounded by swirling glowing light, which fades into the relative
darkness around you without any trace of edges or shadow.
   There is a "No Tipping" notice pinned to the darkness.

rooms.name: A Totally Empty Room
rooms.desc: The walls are completely bare...nothing at all in the room...weird.

rooms.name: Frontline's Sphere
rooms.desc:
You float inside a massive clear glass sphere that seems to be suspended in
fire! If you will yourself, you find that you can move about the sphere with
some difficulty.  Although it is clear that the blazing fires of Hell lie
just outside the walls of this sphere, the atmosphere inside is almost too
comfortable. Many random objects float about in this space with you, some
of which are charred corpses. Hrmm.. hope Frontline isn't mad at you.

rooms.name: Falling...
rooms.desc:
You fall and fall and fall and fall and fall and fall
and fall and fall and fall and fall and fall and fall
and fall and fall and fall and fall and fall....
and then you die.

rooms.name: The Tower of Aralius
rooms.desc:
You stand in a small, circular room atop a tall granite tower.
Below you, you can see the wispy tendrils of cumulus clouds that
conceal the tower from the mortal world below.
   Out the northern window you can see a dark sphere floating in
a layer of suspended ice crystals where the cold emptiness of
space meets the outer reaches of the planet.  A few eruptions of
bright light stream from the sphere, often followed by loud
explosions and swearing.

rooms.name: A Safe Haven
rooms.desc:
This ancient room whispers of unfathomable history and wealth.  Intricate 
marble carvings interlace and entwine within themselves along the thick
columns that line the walls.  Brass-leaf lanterns hang suspended from the
ceiling, bathing everything in an ethereal glow.  Rich, plush rugs cover
the black marble floor, scattered with silken and velvet pillows.  Above,
three cresent moons have been carved from the cathedral ceiling to gaze
upon the heavens above.

rooms.name: Prep Room
rooms.desc:
You find yourself in the prep room for battle, various artifacts and 
weaponry line the walls in honor of the great victors that have passed
before.  Large mystical runes lie to the east, creating a doorway into
the onslaught.  A peaceful aura is settled around the room, allowing 
you to prepare for the battle that awaits.

rooms.name: The Immortal Conference Room
rooms.desc:
You are in a huge stone room.  The walls are made of huge grey-stone blocks
that seem to reach to the sky.  In the center of the room is a huge wooden
table that is perfectly round.  In the center of the table is a large
fire that lights most of the room.  There are torches along the walls that
provide even more light.  There are huge wooden chairs around the room that
allow all of the pantheon to assemble in some sort of order.

rooms.name: The Hall of Fortune
rooms.desc:
You are in a huge room, ballroom-sized, in fact.  Tapestries
of the greatest battles in history adorn the walls.  In glass
cases are some of the most exquisite pieces of art ever created.
Jewels, paintings, swords, rings, goblets - it is all here!  You
must be a welcome guest, for not just anyone should be here.

rooms.name: Roach Coach
rooms.desc:
You are in a seedy, vile place.  What a nasty looking area.  It must breed
some nasty beings.  Little roachs scurry around, but there are some large
footprints here as well.  Strange.

rooms.name: A Stable (Buy 'em Here)
rooms.desc: You are in, imagine this, a stable.  You know.  Where you buy horses.

rooms.name: A Stable (Rent 'em Here)
rooms.desc:
You are in, imagine this, a stable.  You know.  But you don't buy them
here, you give your horse a place to sleep here.

rooms.name: Nevyn's Room
rooms.desc:
The room before you reeks of the sharp, clean smell of plants, spring
growth, rotting leaves, and biting nettles. A large iron cauldron stands in
the center of the room cooking over redly glowing coals. Steam rises from
under the cauldron's lid. The walls are crammed with boxes; the ceiling is
hung with bunches of strange herbs, many of them still fresh. You hear a
sudden scuttling noise, and one of the boxes falls from a shelf, spilling
black seeds over the dirt floor.

rooms.name: Walking the Etherial Plane
rooms.desc:
You are here..yet you are not. This place exists in a single time frame
and nothing else has meaning here. For an instant, you are walking the
hills near the Pagoda, the next you're rowing across a vast ocean. Your
mind is generating many images all of which appear before you.
